sources.title: Vision-LSTM: xLSTM as Generic Vision Backbone - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: Abstract Transformers are widely used as generic backbones in computer vision, despite initially introduced for natural language processing. Recently, the Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) has been extended to a scalable and performant architecture - the xLSTM - which overcomes long-standing LSTM limitations via exponential gating and parallelizable matrix memory structure. sources.snippet: xLSTM as Generic Vision Backbone [Code] [Paper] [Models] [Codebase Demo Video] [BibTeX] We introduce Vision-LSTM (ViL), an adaption of xLSTM to computer vision.
